gate: Meadow Wake opening Blender environment art gate

evidenceRoles.comparisonOrder: quality target left; Blender art-gate render right

textureAccounting.note: Both external images are hidden image empties only; no material, world, or compositor references either image.

terrainSilhouette.deficiency: The connected rise and shallow body read correctly, but the landform still lacks the target's sculpted erosion, undercuts, and convincing geological transitions.

campCraftsmanship.deficiency: The camp has authored beams, braces, ropes, lanterns, footings, steps, a bench, and a sign, but its broad canvas surfaces and joinery still read as an intermediate asset rather than target-level craftsmanship.

treeQuality.deficiency: The tree has a tapered lofted trunk, branch hierarchy, root flare, asymmetry, and individual leaves, but the leaf shapes and bark treatment remain visibly procedural and angular.

rockAndRootIntegration.deficiency: Roots connect to the rise, but too many similarly treated embedded stones read as low-poly wallpaper instead of fewer, stronger formations.

foliageRichness.deficiency: The scene has grass, ferns, flowers, leaf masses, moss, and foreground brambles, yet it lacks the target's layered botanical density and shape refinement.

materialRichness.deficiency: Procedural materials separate all required classes, but they lack authored UV detail, microvariation, edge wear, translucency, and high-frequency texture definition.

depthSeparation.deficiency: Four depth bands are readable, but the mountain, forest, cloud, and waterfall layers remain too graphic and do not blend with target-level haze and spatial complexity.

lightingCohesion.deficiency: Warm key, cool fill, foliage rim, and lantern lights are present, but contact shadows, bounced color, aerial perspective, and local contrast are not yet production quality.

environmentalStorytelling.deficiency: The camp, trail sign, bench, lanterns, block lesson, collectibles, root rise, and transition waterfall form a coherent opening, but the space needs more integrated wear, debris, and landmark specificity.

overallProductionFinish.deficiency: The scene is substantive authored geometry and a useful art-direction gate, but it remains visibly below the supplied target's production finish.

automaticFailureConditionsPresent: broad camp canvas surfaces still read as flat green panels
embedded stones remain too repetitive and low-poly
the finished lighting render remains visibly primitive beside the supplied quality target

revisionHistory.comparisonFinding: The original 8.2 m orthographic width cropped the camp and tree; the imported active-WIP hero export also dominated the frame.
revisionHistory.meaningfulChange: Recomputed the camera to a 14 m width at 16:9 and replaced the conflicting rig import with a tagged 1.82 m environment-only scale mannequin.

revisionHistory.comparisonFinding: The opening fit the frame, but the camp roof, tree canopy, sky, mountains, and midground forest read as sparse flat geometry.
revisionHistory.meaningfulChange: Reshaped the cloth canopy, increased individually modeled leaf density, added a gradient sky, alpine facets, softened cloud geometry, and rebuilt the forest band.

revisionHistory.comparisonFinding: Midground trunks aligned under the blocks and weakened their floating interactive read; terrain and camp storytelling remained sparse.
revisionHistory.meaningfulChange: Cleared the block sightline, added embedded geological variation, face moss, exposed root veins, camp props, and a compass-coin guidance arc.

revisionHistory.comparisonFinding: The color render was clearer but checkpoint evidence did not sufficiently prove forms and topology.
revisionHistory.meaningfulChange: Created locked-camera Workbench blockout/clay checkpoints and an edge-derived Eevee wireframe proof render while retaining the same camera.

provisionalAssets: MW_Hargold_EnvironmentScaleMannequin is a scale reference only because production hero rigs are active WIP and out of scope.
All materials are procedural review materials without final UV-authored texture sets.
Collision, retopology, LODs, export preparation, engine integration, and mobile optimization intentionally remain unstarted.
Clouds, distant mountains, forest silhouettes, and the waterfall require a higher-fidelity art pass.
